name: Marid's Mastery
body:
Source Advanced Race Guide pg. 178
School transmutation [water]; Level arcanist 1, bloodrager 1, cleric 1, druid 1, hunter 1, oracle 1, ranger 1, redmantisassassin 1, sorcerer 1, warpriest 1, witch 1, wizard 1 (undine)
Casting
Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S
Effect
Range touch
Target willing creature touched
Duration 1 minute/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)
Description
The target gains a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls if it and its opponent are touching water. If the opponent or the target is touching the ground, the target takes a –4 penalty on attack and damage rolls.
